## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

**1. Global Risk Regime?**
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 5/11 sectors positive. SPY ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.27% | 1M: +0.44%) and XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.74% | 1M: +12.76%) vs XLK CORRECTION (1W: -1.40% | 1M: +0.03%) show mixed leadership and confirm a neutral market posture.

**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**
Fear DECREASING: VXX (1W: -2.65% | 1M: -14.09%) ↓ falling and BELOW TREND. Credit mixed/neutral: HYG CORRECTION (1W: -0.28% | 1M: +0.16%) and LQD BELOW TREND (1W: -0.74% | 1M: -0.75%) → flat; commodity squeeze from oil: BNO ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.10% | 1M: +23.10%) ↑ rising.

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**
Neutral: SPY ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.27% | 1M: +0.44%) vs TLT BELOW TREND (1W: -0.90% | 1M: -0.74%) leaves the SPY/TLT ratio directionless and financial conditions steady.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**
Energy leading: XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.74% | 1M: +12.76%). Financials in RECOVERY: XLF RECOVERY (1W: +0.74% | 1M: -0.09%). Tech lagging: XLK CORRECTION (1W: -1.40% | 1M: +0.03%); style mixed — rotation into cyclicals but not broad enough to flip regime.

**5. US vs Global?**
US slight edge: SPY ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.27% | 1M: +0.44%). EM mixed: EEM CORRECTION (1W: -0.21% | 1M: +2.66%) while China FXI RECOVERY (1W: +0.28% | 1M: -2.05%).

**6. Speculative Appetite?**
Speculation selective: IBIT ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.34% | 1M: +26.16%) showing strength while ARKK CORRECTION (1W: -0.27% | 1M: +14.39%) and IWM BELOW TREND (1W: -1.54% | 1M: -1.53%) show uneven risk-taking.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**
Bifurcated commodities: Oil strong — USO ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.29% | 1M: +23.69%) and BNO ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.10% | 1M: +23.10%); base metals weaker with CPER BELOW TREND (1W: -0.18% | 1M: -2.30%). Gold taking profits: GLD CORRECTION (1W: -2.93% | 1M: +5.28%).

**8. Energy Trend?**
Energy leadership confirmed: XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.74% | 1M: +12.76%) and UNG ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.58% | 1M: +7.70%) ↑ rising.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**
CONFIRMED: XLE ABOVE TREND on both windows; MINOR DIVERGENCE: XLK CORRECTION (1W neg | 1M near flat) and XLF RECOVERY (1W pos | 1M neg) indicate sector rotation rather than a clean risk regime change; breadth 5/11 keeps the read NEUTRAL.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**
Favor exposure to energy/commodity ETFs (XLE, BNO, USO) and selective crypto (IBIT) showing momentum; reduce exposure to small-cap and cyclically weak ETFs (IWM, SOXX) and monitor GLD/ARKK for reversion signals; bonds remain neutral given TLT BELOW TREND.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**
BULLISH: Energy — XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.74% | 1M: +12.76%) for continued cyclical leadership. BEARISH: Industrials — XLI BELOW TREND (1W: -2.37% | 1M: -6.33%) and Materials — XME in CORRECTION (1W: -3.76% | 1M: +5.77%) to watch for downdraft.

**12. Commodities to Watch?**
BULLISH: Oil — BNO ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.10% | 1M: +23.10%) and USO ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.29% | 1M: +23.69%). BEARISH: Copper/industrial metals — CPER BELOW TREND (1W: -0.18% | 1M: -2.30%) and Silver SLV CORRECTION (1W: -3.54% | 1M: +7.99%) for potential pullback.

**13. Key Levels?**
VXX (1W: -2.65% | 1M: -14.09%) — watch ~20 for complacency signals. HYG (1W: -0.28% | 1M: +0.16%) / LQD (1W: -0.74% | 1M: -0.75%) — monitor HYG/LQD for credit stress. XLK/ XLF spread (XLK CORRECTION | XLF RECOVERY) — watch for a decisive crossover to signal durable rotation.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 5/11 sectors positive, with energy (XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.74% | 1M: +12.76%)) and selective crypto (IBIT ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.34% | 1M: +26.16%)) showing relative strength. Key risk is sector rotation — XLK CORRECTION (1W: -1.40% | 1M: +0.03%) vs XLF RECOVERY (1W: +0.74% | 1M: -0.09%) — monitor for follow-through.
